BrochureContent.Content:
DNG Ryan are delighted to present Loumanagh North, Boherbue, Co. Cork, P51 E8K5 to the market for sale. This attractive four-bedroom, three-bathroom detached bungalow offers spacious and well-proportioned accommodation extending to approximately C. 125 sqm, all set on a generous C. 0.66-acre site in a pleasant countryside setting within close proximity to Boherbue village.

The property represents an excellent opportunity for those seeking a substantial detached family home with the benefit of generous outdoor space. The accommodation is bright and practical throughout, providing four bedrooms and three bathrooms together with comfortable living areas suited to modern family life. A newly fitted kitchen is a particularly attractive feature of the home, providing a fresh and contemporary centrepiece to the property.

Further enhancing the accommodation is a solid-fuel stove, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere within the living space. The property also benefits from a newly installed ceiling-mounted heating system, while PVC windows and doors provide for ease of maintenance and contribute to the overall comfort of the home.

Externally, the residence occupies an impressive site extending to approximately C. 0.66 acres, offering ample outdoor space and excellent potential for a purchaser to further enhance the gardens and grounds to suit their own requirements. A garage positioned to the rear of the property provides valuable additional storage and practical space, complementing the generous nature of the site.

The location offers an appealing balance between rural living and everyday convenience, with Boherbue village located nearby and providing access to a range of local amenities and services. The property's detached setting, generous site and proximity to the village make it particularly well suited to families, first-time buyers or those looking to relocate to a quieter countryside environment without sacrificing convenient access to local facilities.

Importantly, Loumanagh North is being offered to the market vacant and chain free, allowing a prospective purchaser the opportunity to proceed without the complications of an onward property chain.

With its four-bedroom accommodation, newly fitted kitchen, upgraded heating system, detached garage and substantial C. 0.66-acre site, this is an attractive opportunity to acquire a spacious detached home in the popular Boherbue area.

Viewing is highly recommended and is strictly by appointment with the sole selling agents, DNG Ryan.
